title: 第九章 狗吃屎
content_zh:
“我叫陈木，你好。”陈木淡淡的跟苏林依说道，虽然这具身体的原主人，对苏林依爱慕很久，但却不代表现在的陈木依然对苏林依还很爱慕。

    “啊！你不会就是那个被陈家给赶出来的陈木吧。”苏林依到没有说什么，孙依诗直接惊讶的说道，虽然陈木被陈家赶出家门这种丑事，很少有人知道，或者说出了陈木身边的人，也不会有太多的人去关注陈木，当然知道的人少，不代表孙依诗不知道，孙依诗在学校可谓是位百事通，基本上很多八卦新闻她都一清二楚。

    “呃。。。”苏林依看了孙依诗一眼，有些无奈，这小妮子还真是八卦，怎么什么事都知道。她是从来不关注别人的事情的，不过陈木被赶出陈家也是最近两周的事情，而最近两周苏林依的母亲病倒了，她不知道也很正常，毕竟苏林依的母亲病了，孙依诗想要告诉苏林依也一直没有机会。

    “小诗，你怎么说话的！”苏林依瞪了孙依诗一眼，让她说话注意场合，自己的父亲还在车上呢，然后有些歉意对陈木说道：“陈木，小诗她就是这样心直口快，你别介意。”

    “没关系。”陈木淡淡道，陈木本身就不在乎这些，他一开始的想法是找个地方安静修炼度过此生，不过脑海中最后救了自己的那个人，似乎对自己很重要，所以陈木想要提升实力，如果能回到苍月大陆，他便要将那人找出来。

    “依依，这位就是爸之前给你说的那个人，以后他会负责你的安全，所有骚扰你的人都可以交给他。”苏本没有将孙依诗的话当回事，直接对着苏林依说道，陈家的子弟他也见过，可以说随便一个人出来都是社会精英，陈木的父亲能力，他可是一清二楚，如果当年不是陈木的父亲，自己早就死了。

    对于陈木的能力，苏本虽然还没有测试，不过他相信应该不会差，普通人见到自己根本无法做到陈木这般淡定自若。

    “啊！爸，我不是跟你说过，我不要什么人保护吗，怎么你还给我找人？”苏林依脸色有些不好看，她之前就听说了苏本要给自己找个人保护自己，她还以为是个女生，所以当时也没怎么反对，今天一看竟然是个男生，而且似乎还是我们学校的，连小诗都认识，这要是传出去，那别人还以为自己跟陈木有什么事呢。

    “依依姐，不错哦，这人看起来似乎没有传言中那么虎啊，可能真的可以保护依依姐你呢？”孙依诗双眼放光，好像发现什么新大陆一般，兴奋的对着苏林依说道

    “小诗，你乱什么，再乱说我就不理你了。”苏林依对孙依诗有些无奈，不过苏林依在后车镜上，仔细的看了陈木一眼，越看苏林依越是觉得眼熟，总感觉在什么地方见过，不过再仔细一看，发现自己又不认识。

    陈木自然也感觉到了苏林依的目光，不过他根本不担心自己会被苏林依看出来，如果自己一个修真者的修真法术，可以被一个凡人识破，那陈木干脆不要修炼了。

    “依依姐，你为什么一直在后车镜里面偷看陈木，我知道了，你不会动心了吧。”孙依诗明显发现了苏林依的举动，好像恍然大悟一般，戳穿道。

    “小诗，你闭嘴！”苏林依被戳穿，顿时脸色挂不住了，直接对着孙依诗怒道。

    不过孙依诗并没有闭嘴，而是继续对着陈木说道：“陈木，你不是依依姐的打手兼保镖吗，你看后面那个人，一直纠缠着依依姐，你要是现在能教训他一下，依依姐就让你保护了！”

    苏林依见到孙依诗没有闭嘴，还提出这样的要求，实在不知道在说什么了，不过她也想看看陈木的能力如何，如果陈木连王艺都解决不了，那说他能保护自己还真有待考察。

    苏本原本想让女儿不要胡闹，不过话还没来得及说出口，陈木说道：“他吗？”陈木自然从后车镜看到了王艺，便知道了是早上跟在苏林依身边的那个男生，本来陈木就讨厌这家伙，能趁这个机会教训一下王艺，陈木求之不得。

    王艺看到苏林依上车后，脸色有些阴沉，这苏林依软硬不吃，自己已经追了她半年之久了，到了宁华大学后，王艺除了苏林依可是其他女人从来不碰，不是他不敢喷，而是他怕孙依诗知道后，告诉苏林依，自己可就再也没有戏追到苏林依了。

    孙依诗是什么人，王艺可是一清二楚，整个宁华大学，只要是一些八卦，没有孙依诗不知道的。

    “王少，苏林依可是华宇药材公司老总的女儿，就是宁华大学也有他们的赞助，况且苏林依还长得这么美，遇到一些困难也是正常的，你可千万不要灰心啊。”王艺身边冒出一名叫贾小亮的跟班，说道

    “废话，我当然知道，还用你说，只不过我已经追了这苏林依半年多了，她母亲的病，我更是当各种跑腿，没想到还是没有追到。”

    王艺为了追苏林依，基本上整个宁华大学无人不知，在宁华大学王艺也是数一数二的人物，几乎无人敢惹，原因无他，凡是惹了王艺的人，现在基本上没有人能够站得起来的。大多数人都进了医院，更有甚至断腿断绝也很正常

    以前的陈木在宁华大学虽然身份陈家子弟被人高看一等，但以前的陈木同样也没有多高调，身边的朋友也不多，而且很多还是打着他胸口陈家玉坠注意的人，这些陈木都知道，不过现在的陈木自然不是以前陈木能比的，那块代表陈家的玉坠，在他看来不要也罢，而王艺他更没有看在眼里。

    陈木下车后径直走到王艺身边，其实陈木想要教训王艺在很远的距离就可以了，毕竟他有很多小法术可以达到这种目的，不过如果他不走进，难免会暴露自己的本事，或者苏林依她们也不会相信是自己教训的王艺。

    到了王艺身边，见到他跟他旁边的跟班正在商量下一步怎么追苏林依，陈木直接手掐印诀，在陈木走过王艺身边的一瞬间，一道流光进入到了王艺双腿，正在商量事情的王艺，忽然感觉腿脚不是自己的一般，自己的身子竟然直接往前倒去，而自己的面前不知道什么时候多了一滩狗屎。

    在王艺惊吓的目光中，王艺直接来了一个狗吃屎！

    “妈的，谁玩老子？”
content_en:
"My name is Chen Mu, hello." Chen Mu said to Su Linyi calmly. Although the original owner of this body had admired Su Linyi for a long time, it did not mean that Chen Mu still admired Su Linyi now.
"Ah! You can't be the Chen Mu who was kicked out by the Chen family." Su Linyi didn't say anything, and Sun Yishi said in surprise. Although few people knew about the scandal of Chen Mu being kicked out by the Chen family, or told the people around Chen Mu, not many people paid attention to Chen Mu. Of course, few people knew, but it didn't mean that Sun Yishi didn't know. Sun Yishi was a know-it-all in school, and she knew basically all the gossip news.
"Uh..." Su Linyi glanced at Sun Yishi, a little helpless. This little girl is really a gossip. How come she knows everything.She never pays attention to other people's affairs, but Chen Mu was kicked out of the Chen family in the past two weeks, and Su Linyi's mother fell ill in the past two weeks. It was normal for her not to know. After all, Su Linyi's mother was ill, and Sun Yishi never had the chance to tell Su Linyi.
"Xiao Shi, why are you talking!" Su Linyi glared at Sun Yi Shi and told her to pay attention to the occasion when she spoke. Her father was still in the car, and then said to Chen Mu apologetically: "Chen Mu, Xiao Shi is so outspoken, don't mind."
"It doesn't matter." Chen Mu said lightly. Chen Mu himself didn't care about this. His initial idea was to find a place to practice quietly and spend his life. However, the person who saved him in the end seemed to be very important to him, so Chen Mu wanted to improve his strength. If he could return to Cangyue Continent, he would find that person.
"Yiyi, this is the person Dad told you before. He will be responsible for your safety in the future. Anyone who harasses you can be handed over to him." Su Ben did not take Sun Yishi's words seriously and said directly to Su Linyi. He has also seen the children of the Chen family. It can be said that any one of them is a social elite. Chen Mu's father's abilities are clear to him. If he was not Chen Mu's father, he would have died long ago.
Although Su Ben has not yet tested Chen Mu's ability, he believes that it should be good. Ordinary people would never be able to be as calm and composed as Chen Mu when they see him.
"Ah! Dad, didn't I tell you that I don't want anyone to protect me? Why are you still looking for someone for me?" Su Linyi's face looked a little ugly. She had heard before that Su Ben wanted to find someone to protect her. She thought it was a girl, so she didn't object much at the time. Today it turned out to be a boy, and he seemed to be from our school. Even Xiao Shi knew him. If this spread, others would think that she and Chen Mu had something to do with each other.
"Sister Yiyi, that's good. This person doesn't seem to be as fierce as the rumors say. Maybe he can really protect you, Sister Yiyi?" Sun Yishi's eyes lit up, as if she had discovered some new continent, and she said excitedly to Su Linyi
"Xiao Shi, what are you talking about? If you keep talking nonsense, I will ignore you." Su Linyi was a little helpless towards Sun Yi Shi, but Su Linyi looked at Chen Mu carefully in the rear mirror. The more he looked at Su Linyi, the more familiar he felt. He always felt that he had seen him somewhere, but when he looked closer, he found that he didn't recognize him.
Chen Mu naturally felt Su Linyi's gaze, but he was not worried that he would be seen by Su Linyi. If his cultivation spell as a cultivator could be seen through by a mortal, then Chen Mu might as well stop cultivating.
"Sister Yiyi, why have you been peeking at Chen Mu in the rear mirror? I understand. You won't be tempted." Sun Yishi clearly noticed Su Linyi's behavior and said as if she suddenly realized it.
"Xiao Shi, shut up!" When Su Linyi was exposed, his expression suddenly lost control and he shouted angrily at Sun Yishi.
However, Sun Yishi did not shut up, but continued to say to Chen Mu: "Chen Mu, aren't you Sister Yiyi's thug and bodyguard? Look at the man behind, who has been pestering Sister Yiyi. If you can teach him a lesson now, Sister Yiyi will let you protect him!"
When Su Linyi saw that Sun Yishi didn't shut up and made such a request, she really didn't know what she was talking about. However, she also wanted to see what Chen Mu's abilities were. If Chen Mu couldn't even deal with Wang Yi, then it really remains to be seen whether he could protect herself.
Su Ben originally wanted his daughter to stop messing around, but before he could say anything, Chen Mu said, "He?" Chen Mu naturally saw Wang Yi in the rear mirror, and knew that it was the boy who followed Su Linyi in the morning. Chen Mu originally hated this guy, so he could take this opportunity to teach Wang Yi a lesson. Chen Mu could only wish for it.
When Wang Yi saw Su Linyi get into the car, his face became gloomy. This Su Linyi refused to take the hard way. He had been chasing her for half a year. After arriving at Ninghua University, Wang Yi had never touched any other woman except Su Linyi. It was not that he did not dare to complain, but that he was afraid that when Sun Yishi knew about it, he would tell Su Linyi that he would no longer be able to chase Su Linyi.
Wang Yi knew very well who Sun Yishi was. In the entire Ninghua University, as long as there was some gossip, there was nothing Sun Yishi didn't know about.
"Master Wang, Su Linyi is the daughter of the boss of Huayu Medicinal Materials Company. Ninghua University is also sponsored by them. Besides, Su Linyi is so beautiful. It is normal to encounter some difficulties. Don't be discouraged." A follower named Jia Xiaoliang appeared next to Wang Yi and said
"Nonsense, of course I know. It doesn't matter what you say. It's just that I have been chasing Su Linyi for more than half a year. Her mother is ill, and I have been doing various errands. Unexpectedly, I still haven't caught her."
In order to pursue Su Linyi, Wang Yi is basically known to everyone in Ninghua University. Wang Yi is also one of the best in Ninghua University. Almost no one dares to offend him. There is no other reason. Anyone who offends Wang Yi is basically no one who can stand up now.Most people end up in the hospital, and even having their legs amputated is normal.
In the past, although Chen Mu was regarded as a child of the Chen family at Ninghua University, he did not have a high profile and did not have many friends around him. Many of them were people who paid attention to the Chen family jade pendant on his chest. Chen Mu knew these things, but the current Chen Mu was naturally not comparable to the previous Chen Mu. In his opinion, the jade pendant representing the Chen family was not a problem, and Wang Yi did not pay attention to it.
After Chen Mu got off the car, he walked straight to Wang Yi. In fact, if Chen Mu wanted to teach Wang Yi a lesson, he could do it from a long distance. After all, he had many small spells that could achieve this purpose. However, if he didn't walk in, he would inevitably expose his own abilities, or Su Linyi and the others would not believe that he was the one who taught Wang Yi.
When he arrived at Wang Yi's side, he saw that he and the follower next to him were discussing how to pursue Su Linyi next. Chen Mu directly made seals with his hands. The moment Chen Mu walked past Wang Yi, a stream of light entered Wang Yi's legs. Wang Yi, who was discussing the matter, suddenly felt that his legs and feet were not his own. His body fell forward directly, and there was a puddle of dog shit in front of him.
In Wang Yi's frightened eyes, Wang Yi immediately came to eat shit!
"Damn it, who's playing with me?"
